checklist.name: canonical preservation
checklist.procedure: Hash embedded original YAML bytes. Reconstruct the named geometry without replacing it with Teagan or testmodel. Compare line, vertex and text records with source.
checklist.expected: Exact source hash and complete source-to-render mapping. Unknown values stay unknown.

checklist.name: unknown units
checklist.procedure: Load golden with U-to-mm unset. Inspect measurements, exports, simulation status and reports.
checklist.expected: U measurements remain U. Physical cutting and golden fit verdict are BLOCKED. No implicit scale of 1.

checklist.name: demo isolation
checklist.procedure: Switch to official testmodel or normalized demo. Run it. Switch back to golden.
checklist.expected: Distinct source ID and DEMO_ASSUMED label. Demo results cannot become golden results.

checklist.name: single revision
checklist.procedure: Edit geometry while a solver job runs. Wait for the old job to finish. Inspect all five views and export.
checklist.expected: All views agree on active revision. Old results remain STALE and cannot overwrite active results.

checklist.name: actual recomputation
checklist.procedure: Record initial solver step and position hash. Run fixed steps. Reset and change a meaningful input, then rerun.
checklist.expected: LIVE_SOLVE invokes the engine. Steps and output are traceable to current input. Replay is explicitly REPLAY and never increments solver work counters.

checklist.name: single HTML startup
checklist.procedure: Open the exact delivered HTML in a fresh browser context without network. Start, stop and reset computation.
checklist.expected: Embedded code, WASM and assets initialize without CDN. UI remains usable. Failure is visible rather than replaced by cached output.

checklist.name: seam semantics
checklist.procedure: Inspect seam pair mapping, orientation, approvals, particle IDs and engine edge rest lengths. Perturb a minimal connected fixture and run it.
checklist.expected: Measured behavior matches declared native constraint or welded connectivity. Shared-index zero gap is not reported as dynamic sewing proof.

checklist.name: rest metric preservation
checklist.procedure: Compare every structural edge rest length and every triangle rest metric against panel-local 2D data. Inspect welded seam corner UVs.
checklist.expected: No silent metric reset from preassembled 3D shape. Discrepancies and assumed metrics are explicit.

checklist.name: stress honesty
checklist.procedure: Inspect heatmap legend, values, units and exported report. Read Rapier edgeStress and edgeImpulse usage.
checklist.expected: Dimensionless strain and normalized tear load use correct labels. Physical stress remains UNKNOWN without calibrated constitutive data.

checklist.name: collision identity and audit
checklist.procedure: Compare render and collider body vertex/index hashes and transforms. Audit output cloth against body and itself with the independent geometry checker.
checklist.expected: Same body mesh and transform. Report intersections, penetrations, degeneracies and tolerance. No image-only PASS.

checklist.name: run reproducibility and bounds
checklist.procedure: Export run parameters, source and mesh hashes, engine version, dt, steps and stop reason. Repeat bounded fixture and test cancellation.
checklist.expected: Reproducible inputs and declared numerical tolerance. Cancellation works. Runtime limits do not silently reduce collision fidelity.

checklist.name: historical and production claims
checklist.procedure: Read final UI, downloaded report and final delivery text. Compare historical status with repository rules.
checklist.expected: Old garment FAIL persists. New probe PASS is scoped to its fixture. Missing production inputs cannot produce golden physics PASS.
